numeric_field_time_comparison.noise_floor_caveat: One positive uniform theta perturbation on the original defective build, not a statistical sensitivity distribution or a corrected-build noise floor.

first_production_ysu_replay.method: First actual PhysicsDriver._run_ysu inputs after the preceding production atmosphere/radiation/surface/Noah work; original sealed case and corrected build. Captured before running the full-domain YSU call, replayed seven exact FP32 column inputs on Metal and the existing float64 NumPy mirror. Scalar psim/psih use the actual FM/FH fields, not similarly named history fields. Float64 mirror is not an exact CUDA arithmetic oracle; close agreement or disagreement does not alone identify the first CUDA/Metal operation. Capture deliberately stops here, before completing the first model timestep.

numeric_literal_audit.method: Comment/string-stripped source census. f-suffixed literals normalized to stored float32; unsuffixed literals to float64. 16-hex-digit words additionally decoded as possible software FP64. Factor-of-ten tolerance permits float32 rounding. Preprocessor branch braces balanced without choosing one configuration. Function names/source-verified overrides matched first; other renamed functions paired heuristically and marked. Flags are review candidates, not correctness failures. File-scope literals, multiplicity differences and unmatched functions are retained. No integer-expression evaluation, operator/control-flow validation or proof of every semantic pairing.

factor10_review.reason: CUDA 0.25 is the GSD stability exponent; Metal 2.5e6 is latent heat. Not corresponding coefficients.
